narr: A low pressure system brought heavy rainfall to the region as it moved through the Ohio Valley.
ev: State Route 41 was closed at Kimberly Drive due to water flowing over the roadway.
A swift water rescue was needed for a camper that was surrounded by fast moving water on Pauline Miller Road.
State Route 139 was closed at White Gravel-McDaniel Road due to fast moving water over the roadway.
A slab bridge was partially washed away along Upper Twin Creek-Rocky Fork Road.
